about_the_game:
Step into the dangerous world of cartel building with this free demo – a first taste of the full crime empire simulation.

What you’ll experience in this demo:

  • Tutorial + First City: Learn the ropes and start carving your place in the underworld.

  • Farm, Process, Deliver: Grow your first crops, process the product, and fulfill risky customer orders.

  • Early Challenges: Face rival gangs and dodge small-scale police patrols that test your survival instincts.

  • Limited Workforce: Hire a handful of workers to keep your operations running smoothly.

What awaits you in the full game:

  • Bigger, bolder empire building with multiple cities and even an island stronghold.

  • More products and production chains to expand your operation and profits.

  • Advanced logistics that scale from vans to trucks and even airplane shipments.

  • High-stakes battles with rival cartels, heavier police presence, and a wider arsenal of weapons.

  • A full storyline with deeper economy, larger missions, and long-term cartel management.

⚠️ Progress from the demo will not carry over to the full game.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains fictional depictions of crime, drug production and trafficking, gun violence, and adult themes. It does not provide real-world instructions or promote illegal activities.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit) or higher
  • Processor: 3 GHZ 4 Core or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 or Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 14 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit) or higher
  • Processor: 4 GHZ 6 Core or similar
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Storage: 14 GB available space

short_description: Start as a small producer, produce and distribute. Fight rival gangs and become the baron of two cities.
